plain_italian_summary: Gli agenti approvano il bundle Score Pack 1k + Action Pack 25 come candidato pre-live da modellare, ma non autorizzano la vendita reale. Il live commerciale resta bloccato finche' non passano fiscalita', legal/privacy, pagamenti, API key produzione, supporto automatico e cost guard.

agent_votes.reason: The bundle is coherent and lower-risk than launching all products, but live gates are still blocked.
Pricing can be modeled, but no payments or invoices until fiscal/billing gate passes.
Score and Action Pack have clear machine-readable contracts, but production API key process is not live-ready.
Bundle positioning is strong for machine buyers: score first, then action payload. Distribution must remain passive.
No paid launch until terms, privacy, no-guarantee language and data rules are approved.
Support model is promising, but live support automation and escalation rules need a final readiness test.

conditions_before_live: privacy and data processing rules approved

recommended_next_action.name: pre_live_readiness_matrix
recommended_next_action.plain_italian: Creare una matrice finale dei gate live: per ogni condizione indicare stato, evidenza disponibile, cosa manca, agente responsabile e se serve decisione del proprietario.
